title: Randy Anderson taken to an underground facility at Crane
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Randy Anderson taken to an underground facility at Crane, about unspecified at Crane, Indiana, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like Randy Anderson who I've interviewed who you know said he was taken down to an underground facility you know at Crane Indiana
And then Randy Anderson is this guy who was taken underground, you know, at um Crane Naval Surface Warfare Crane, and was possibly shown some off-world technology.
tellings.difference: Adds that he was possibly shown off-world technology there and names the site as Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Randy Anderson being taken to an underground facility at Crane, Indiana, as told by Jesse Michels.

as_told.place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: then we did a show with later is Randy Anderson talks about being at uh Naval Service Warfare Crane he's taken down in some elevator goes deep below you know the ground
tellings.difference: Adds that he went down by elevator, deep below ground, and names the Off-World Technologies Division.
tellings.link_reason: Same account: Randy Anderson taken underground at NSWC Crane and possibly shown off-world technology.

tellings.quote: I'm looking at it and it and it almost looked like a mirage type of effect.
tellings.difference: Told firsthand, and names the object as a gauntlet with holographic symbols that looked like a mirage.
tellings.link_reason: Anderson's own account of what he was shown underground at Crane is the same visit as the story of him being taken to the underground facility there and shown possible off-world technology.
